question: _______ tax is imposed on transactions that have a negative externality; for example, pollution.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pigovian**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pigouvian taxes **are taxes levied against **private individuals or businesses** for engaging in a specific **activity that causes a certain negative effect** on a commercial activity which affects other parties without this being reflected. Ex-** Causing environmental pollution**.
 
• Tax is **named after economist Arthur C. Pigou**, who mention or draw the** idea from his book The Economics of Welfare, 192**0.
 
• **Arun Jaitley** announced an increase in securities transaction taxes on **equity options from 0.017% to 0.05%**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****__Tax Definition__**

__
 
• A tax is a **legal fee or financial charge** levied by the government on an individual or an organization.

***​Type of Taxes__***

 
• **Direct tax -**Direct taxes are those in which the **point of impact and point of the incident will fall on the same entity**. A direct tax **cannot be transferred** by an individual to another person, example-**Income tax and corporate tax**.
 
• **Indirect tax-**Indirect tax is a type of tax where** the point of incident and impact does not fall on the same entity**. The burden of tax **can be transferred **by the taxpayer to another person, for example- **GST and Custom Duty**.

 
 

 **Taxes**
 **Meaning and Levied By**
 
 

 Income tax
 
 
Tax is applicable on the income earned by an individual or taxpayer.

 
Collected by the Central government.

 
 
 

 Corporate tax
 
 
The tax is applicable to the profits earned by companies from their businesses.

 
Collected by the Central Government

 
 
 

 GST
 
 
One Nation One Tax levied on goods and services used by the taxpayer.

 
Collected by the Central and State Government.

 
 
 

 Custom Duty
 
 
The tax is levied on the import and export of goods.

 
Collected by Central Government.
